REFERENCE-LED SCENES

Keep the beauty. Earn the wings.

Yan’s public boy identity comes through grooming, clothing and restraint—not a masculinized face. The exceptionally beautiful, delicate feminine face stays age-appropriate. The accepted portrait is a working direction; new scenes and companion designs are still provisional.
